title: Krait Mk II (Elite Dangerous)
intro: The Krait Mk II by Faulcon DeLacy is a medium multi-role ship that can carry a fighter hangar. Its cockpit has the pilot seat, a multicrew seat and a seat for the fighter pilot. The fighter launch and its orders are on the role panel; the preset puts them on no HOTAS button.

panels.name: Krait Mk II: seats and hardpoints
panels.text: Facts about the Krait Mk II that set it apart from the other ships: its seats, its weapon mounts and the landing pad size it needs.
panels.context: Everything else in the Krait Mk II's cockpit works like in every other Elite Dangerous ship.

controls.name: Pilot seat (helm)
controls.text: The pilot's seat of the Krait Mk II, the helm. Whoever sits here flies the ship and has the whole HOTAS layout of this guide.
controls.context: The Krait Mk II takes up to three people in all; the other seats are for crew who join in multicrew.

controls.name: Multicrew seats
controls.text: The extra seats of the Krait Mk II, for up to three crew in all. A friend who joins can sit here as gunner, or as fighter controller when the ship carries a fighter.
controls.context: A gunner works the turreted weapons while the pilot flies; the roles are chosen on the role panel.

controls.name: Fighter pilot seat
controls.text: The seat from which a crew member or a hired pilot flies the small fighter that the Krait Mk II can carry in a hangar.
controls.context: The fighter is launched and given orders on the role panel; the preset has no HOTAS button for that.

controls.name: Hardpoints (weapon mounts)
controls.text: The weapon mounts of the Krait Mk II: three large and two medium hardpoints. Bigger mounts take bigger, stronger weapons.
controls.context: The pilot puts the Krait Mk II's weapons into fire groups on the right panel and fires them with the trigger and the weapon release button.

controls.name: Landing pad size
controls.text: The Krait Mk II needs a medium landing pad or a bigger one. Stations have small, medium and large pads, and small outposts may not have the bigger ones.
controls.context: When the pilot asks a station for docking, the station gives a pad that fits the ship's size.
